pages.text: Uranium is the fuel of nuclear power. Its ingots go into $(l:nuclear/fuel_rod)Fuel Rods$(/l) for the $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l).

$(li)$(l)Uranium Ore$() is rare and found deep in the Overworld, from $(l)Y 16$() down to the bottom of the world. It is most common around $(l)Y -24$().$(br)$(li)Its yellow-green clumps glow faintly in the dark.
pages.title: Finding it

pages.text: $(li)Mine it with at least an $(l)iron pickaxe$(). Fortune gives more Raw Uranium; Silk Touch gives the ore block itself.

$(li)$(item)Raw Uranium$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Uranium Ingot$()$(br)$(li)$(l:nuclear/fuel_rod)Fuel Rod$(/l)$(br)$(li)Smelt $(l)Raw Uranium$() (or the ore) in a furnace or blast furnace into a $(l)Uranium Ingot$().$(br)$(li)Craft 3 Uranium Ingots and 6 Iron Ingots into a $(l:nuclear/fuel_rod)Fuel Rod$(/l).
pages.title: From ore to fuel

pages.text: Uranium uses the common c: tags, so ore processors and machines from other mods handle it too.
